guidance_for_write_dockerfile_agent: The Dockerfile build is failing at the step installing Python 3.11 and associated packages (python3.11, python3.11-venv, python3.11-distutils). The error message is: 'E: Unable to locate package python3.11', which indicates that the Ubuntu 20.04 default repositories do not have Python 3.11 packages available. To fix this, modify the Dockerfile to add the deadsnakes PPA (https://launchpad.net/~deadsnakes/+archive/ubuntu/ppa) before the apt-get install step, which provides newer Python versions for Ubuntu 20.04. For example, add the commands to install software-properties-common if not already installed (which you already have), then run 'add-apt-repository ppa:deadsnakes/ppa' and 'apt-get update' before installing python3.11 and related packages. This will allow the apt package manager to locate and install Python 3.11 and its venv and distutils packages.
